markers: [GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: It is dawn, as it must be for a sermon to the Morninglord, and the party reaches the Spire's threshold to find clerics at the doors and a crowd of many factions already gathered.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Among the crowd stand Lathanderite clerics watching the party with open skepticism.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Several agents of Loviatar wait in the shadows, and their grievance is that the searing sacrament belongs to the goddess of pain — its use here is theft, and heresy.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Lord Neverember himself stands among the crowd, and beyond the named factions there is a wider audience of the faithful and the curious, all arrived very early — with the sense of factions within factions the party does not recognize.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The armorsmith of Dragonscales Are Us has arrived with the white dragon scale armor, finished after a night's work, and begins fitting it onto Valphine at the threshold; he wants Lathander's blessing on it, not custom.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The sight of a drow cleric being fitted in dragon scale at the temple door sets off whispers and commentary through the crowd, and the smith stands back very proud of himself.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The crowd is impressed and in awe of the spellcasting — a Daylight spell inside the church at dawn is not a common sight — and some of them squint against the glare.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Before Valphine can reach the pulpit, Brother Aldric asks to see her first in a private receiving chamber; he ponders all the liturgical and ceremonial elements she has skipped, tells her she was not supposed to do that, and yet is in a good mood.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Brother Aldric, with a concerned look, says he has heard of the blessed temple built in Phandalin.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Aldric asks what she means by this blessing she keeps talking about — what it is, and whether it is about pain or about redemption and understanding the Morninglord's path.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Aldric accepts her theological points but warns her to stay away from this path of pain, which is not Lathander's way.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The scarred sun priest interrupts to ask whether pain is the point, or the healing.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The sun priest presses her on why she insists on the pain.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The priest asks one last question: then what is the purpose of the healing?]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Aldric, very pleased, makes the sign of the Morninglord.]
